# Session Reflection Feature Request and Approved BDD
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

**Status:** Approved for implementation
**Approved:** 2026-11-12
**Branch:** `codex/session-reflection` (published from `origin/staging`)

This feature request adds a Reflection tab to every Learning Session. The behavior below is the approved acceptance boundary for implementation.

## Requested outcome

Each Learning Session has a **Reflection** tab where participants can leave a reflection about that session.

## Current behavior

The session page has **Session Materials** and **Q&A** tabs. Participants can open published, non-archived sessions after gaining portal access. Administrators can also open draft and archived sessions. These rules are defined in the [session page](../application/source/resources/js/pages/sessions/show.tsx), [session controller](../application/source/app/Http/Controllers/LearningSessionController.php), and [protected routes](../application/source/routes/web.php).

## Approved behavior

The requester approved these choices on 2026-11-12.

| Decision | Proposed behavior |
|---|---|
| Who can read reflections? | Anyone with access to that session can read its submitted reflections. Show the author's name and submission date. State this audience beside the form before submission. |
| How many reflections? | One saved reflection per participant per session. Participants can edit it or delete it and submit again. |
| What can participants write? | One required plain-text field, up to 5,000 characters. Keep paragraph breaks. No attachments or required prompts. |
| Who can change reflections? | Authors can edit and delete their own reflections. Administrators can read and delete any reflection, but cannot rewrite another person's words. |
| When can participants submit? | Whenever the session is published and not archived. No video-completion rule, attendance rule, deadline, or approval step. |
| How are reflections shown? | Show the current participant's saved reflection with its controls, then other reflections from newest to oldest. Mark edited reflections. |
| What is included initially? | Writing, reading, editing, and deleting reflections. Comments, reactions, notifications, grading, exports, and a separate administrator reporting page are outside this draft. |

## BDD scenarios

These scenarios describe the proposed experience. “Approved participant” means a signed-in participant who meets the portal's access rules, including email verification where required.

```gherkin
Feature: Leave a reflection for a Learning Session
  As an approved participant
  I want to record what I learned from a session
  So that I can reflect on it and share my learning

  Background:
    Given I am an approved participant
    And I have opened a published session that is not archived

  Scenario: Open the Reflection tab
    When I select "Reflection"
    Then I see reflections for the current session
    And I can still switch to "Session Materials" and "Q&A"
    And the session recording remains available when attached

  Scenario: Open Reflection before anyone has submitted
    Given the session has no reflections
    When I select "Reflection"
    Then I see "No reflections yet"
    And I see a reflection form
    And the form explains who can read my reflection

  Scenario: Submit my first reflection
    Given I have no saved reflection for this session
    When I enter valid reflection text
    And I select "Submit reflection"
    Then one reflection is saved under my account for this session
    And I see a success message and my saved text
    And my name and submission date are shown
    And I can edit or delete my reflection
    And it remains available after I reload or return later

  Scenario: Read another participant's reflection
    Given another participant has submitted a reflection for this session
    When I select "Reflection"
    Then I see their reflection, name, and submission date
    And other participants' reflections appear from newest to oldest
    And I cannot edit or delete their reflection

  Scenario: Keep reflections separate for each session
    Given I have saved a reflection for a different session
    When I open "Reflection" in the current session
    Then the other session's reflection is not shown
    And I can submit a separate reflection for the current session

  Scenario Outline: Reject invalid reflection text
    When I submit <text>
    Then I see <message> beside the reflection field
    And no reflection is created or changed
    And my entered text stays in the form

    Examples:
      | text                         | message                                  |
      | an empty value               | "Enter a reflection"                     |
      | only spaces or line breaks   | "Enter a reflection"                     |
      | more than 5,000 characters    | "Use 5,000 characters or fewer"           |

  Scenario: Accept text at the character limit
    Given I have no saved reflection for this session
    When I submit valid text containing exactly 5,000 characters
    Then my reflection is saved successfully

  Scenario: Prevent a second reflection for the same participant and session
    Given my reflection for this session has already been saved
    When I try to create another reflection for the same session
    Then only one reflection exists for me in this session
    And my saved reflection is not overwritten by the duplicate submission
    And I am directed to edit my existing reflection

  Scenario: Edit my reflection
    Given I have a saved reflection for this session
    When I select "Edit" and save valid replacement text
    Then my existing reflection shows the updated text
    And it is marked as edited
    And its author and original submission date remain the same
    And no additional reflection is created

  Scenario: Cancel an edit
    Given I am editing my saved reflection
    When I cancel the edit
    Then the saved reflection remains unchanged

  Scenario: Delete my reflection
    Given I have a saved reflection for this session
    When I select "Delete"
    Then I am asked to confirm deletion
    When I confirm deletion
    Then the reflection is no longer shown to anyone
    And I see a success message
    And I can submit a new reflection for this session

  Scenario: Cancel deletion
    Given I am asked to confirm deletion of my reflection
    When I cancel
    Then my reflection remains unchanged

  Scenario: Deny changes to another participant's reflection
    Given another participant owns a reflection
    When I try to edit or delete it through a direct request
    Then the request is denied
    And their reflection remains unchanged

  Scenario: Deny a request using the wrong session
    Given a reflection belongs to a different session
    When I try to edit or delete it through the current session
    Then the request is denied
    And the reflection remains unchanged

  Scenario Outline: Deny access without current portal permission
    Given my access state is <state>
    When I try to read, submit, edit, or delete a reflection
    Then the action is blocked by the portal's access rules
    And no reflection text is disclosed or changed

    Examples:
      | state                                      |
      | signed out                                 |
      | pending administrator approval             |
      | revoked                                    |
      | inactive                                   |
      | email unverified when verification is required |

  Scenario Outline: Block participant access to an unavailable session
    Given the session is <state>
    When I try to read, submit, edit, or delete its reflections
    Then access is denied even through a direct request
    And no reflection is created or changed

    Examples:
      | state       |
      | unpublished |
      | archived    |

  Scenario: Keep saved reflections when a session becomes available again
    Given I saved a reflection before the session became unavailable
    When the session is published and not archived again
    Then my saved reflection is available again

  Scenario: Let an administrator remove a reflection
    Given I am signed in as an administrator with portal access
    When I open a session's Reflection tab
    Then I can read its reflections and delete any reflection after confirmation
    And I cannot edit another person's reflection even through a direct request
    When I confirm deletion of a reflection
    Then it is no longer shown to anyone

  Scenario: Handle a failed save
    Given I have entered a new reflection or edited an existing one
    When saving fails
    Then I see an error and no success message
    And my entered text remains available to retry
    And the form does not show the attempted text as successfully saved

  Scenario: Display reflection text safely
    Given a saved reflection contains paragraphs and HTML or script text
    When I read the reflection
    Then paragraph breaks are preserved
    And HTML or script text is displayed as text and is not executed

  Scenario: Use Reflection on mobile and with a keyboard
    When I open Reflection on a narrow mobile screen
    Then its text, field, and actions fit without horizontal page scrolling
    And I can select the tab and use the form with a keyboard
    And the field has a readable label
    And success and error messages are announced to screen readers
```

## Approved boundary

Reflections are shared with anyone who can access the session. Each participant has one reflection per session, with plain text limited to 5,000 characters. Authors can edit or delete their own reflection; administrators can delete any reflection but cannot edit another person's words. Comments, reactions, notifications, grading, exports, and a separate administrator reporting page remain outside this increment.

The related PM Control records are CHG-55 (Add a shared per-session Reflection tab), D-79 (Approve the session Reflection tab and behavior), and ACT-87 (Implement and verify the session reflection feature).
